effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Tapirmon] and 1 2-color black card among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a 2-color black Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
